steps.message:
Route the overhead MEP of the hardest hall in the corpus, clash-free (dc_model hall_seed005_d100)

Situation

You are the MEP coordinator for a data hall — and this one is deliberately difficult. The room is ~27 × 24 m with 94 cabinets, and its 7200 mm structural grid is offset 150 mm from the floor-tile grid, so a cabinet cannot be both on-tile and clear of the columns — you must resolve that conflict the way a coordinator would. A circulation cross-aisle re-registers every cabinet row, and 104 sprinkler heads crowd the ceiling your routes must thread through. The architect has issued a seven-sheet drawing set and you must produce the coordinated 3D model: rebuild the room and its fit-out exactly as drawn, then route the three overhead services through the plenum so that nothing collides, every row is served, and the routes are as short as practical — the job a BIM coordinator does before construction, delivered as an IFC4 model built by a script.

Inputs (under input/ — seven PNG drawing sheets, nothing else)

A-101 equipment plan · A-301 building section · A-601 cabinet schedule · A-602 containment/pathway/construction data · M-101 chilled water · E-101 busway & PDU · F-101 sprinkler grid.

They behave like a real drawing set: positions on the plan, sizes in the schedule, elevations only in the section callout. No JSON side-channel, no coordinate dump. Reconcile them yourself (read them as images).

Goal

Rebuild the hall as the coordination background: racks on their floor tiles with correct facings, structural columns, CRAHs, PDUs, access floor, containment, and every sprinkler head — your routes are clash-checked against all of it.

Route three overhead services from the entries marked on M-101/E-101 — telecom cable tray, power busway, chilled-water pipe — as straight axis-aligned segments (every direction or tier change is a new segment). Tray and busway must serve every rack row; chilled water must serve every row and reach every CRAH, including the perimeter units no row header passes.

Constraints (all checked mechanically)

Zero hard clashes — one solid overlapping another by > 2 mm anywhere (a tray through a column, a pipe through a rack) fails the task. Columns run full clear height.

Connectivity — each service must form ONE connected network reaching its service entry; every row served along ≥ 80 % of its length by all three services (within 2500 mm across the row); chilled water within 2500 mm of every CRAH.

Code compliance — 2600 mm min headroom; 460 mm kept clear below every sprinkler deflector (plus the NFPA 13 obstruction rule within 450 mm below a deflector); heads required beneath runs wider than 1200 mm and beneath containment roofs; 300 mm separation between tray and busway on at least one axis; no chilled water in the 1800 mm dedicated space above a PDU; 25.4 mm pipe insulation counts in clashes. The under-floor plenum is usable for routing.

Modelling contract — IFC4 via ifcopenshell==0.8.4 (+ numpy only), millimetre project units (but placement-matrix translations in metres!), 2D profile points only, the prescribed spatial structure, exact element classes (e.g. racks = IfcFurniture/USERDEFINED/"Rack") and the required Pset_DCM_* property sets, correct facing rotations about the footprint centre. Validate with express_rules=True before submitting. The script must run headless in 300 s, deterministically, with no network and no reading the PNGs back — bake everything you read off the drawings into the script as literals.

Expected output

One self-contained Python script at output/solution.py that builds the model with ifcopenshell and writes one IFC4 file to sys.argv[1] (default output/model.ifc).

Scoring: schema gate → clash gate → connectivity gate (each 0 if failed), then score = compliance × min(1, L_opt / L_yours) — material efficiency against the reference route, discounted by code violations.

Additional requirements

In addition to the original modelling, routing, clash, connectivity and code-compliance obligations, the solver shall also produce the following design-quality data.  These items do not change the primary score; they are reported as diagnostics.

1. Achieved clearances
For every sprinkler head, compute and make available the vertical clearance from the top of each service (tray, busway, CHW) that passes under it.  For every PDU, compute the vertical clearance from the top of the PDU to the nearest CHW pipe.  For every tray-busway pair, compute the minimum separation on any axis.  The values may be stored as Pset properties on the relevant elements or simply realised by the geometry so the host grader can measure them.

2. Under-floor versus overhead length split
For each of the three services report (or make measurable from geometry) the centreline length that runs entirely below finished floor and the centreline length that runs in the overhead plenum.  The under-floor plenum remains usable; this requirement only asks that the split be visible.

3. Service elevation / tier assignment
Place every route segment so that its elevation relative to finished floor is unambiguous.  Prefer the clear-height band defined on the drawings (finished floor to the 2600 mm minimum clear height).  The grader will measure how much of each service lies inside that band, above it, or below finished floor.

4. Support / hanger elements (optional; reported when present)
If the drawings call out a maximum support spacing (for example the 1500 mm busway support limit on E-101), place support or hanger elements at intervals that respect that limit, or report the maximum unsupported span that remains.  Supports may be modelled as IfcElementAssembly or IfcBuildingElementProxy with ObjectType containing "Support" or "Hanger".

5. Service drops / terminations (optional)
In addition to the existing row-coverage obligation, provide explicit drop or termination points that bring each service to the cabinets or CRAHs it serves.  Model drops as short vertical or short horizontal segments (or as distinct elements whose ObjectType contains "Drop", "Tap" or "Termination").  The grader counts them and records their locations.

6. Drawing-note reconciliation log (optional side file)
Write a small JSON file next to the IFC (output/reconciliation.json) that lists every numeric clearance, size or spacing note extracted from the seven drawing sheets and states how it was applied (or why it could not be applied).  Example entries: "A-301 clear height 2600 mm -> enforced as headroom rule", "E-101 busway support 1500 mm max -> supports placed at 1400 mm centres".  Absence of the file is not a gate failure; its presence is reported.

All gates, the modelling contract, the runtime limit and the primary score formula remain exactly as stated above.  The additional data above are diagnostics only.

# Read PNG files as raw bytes and parse manually
import struct

def read_png_info(path):
    with open(path, 'rb') as f:
        data = f.read()
    
    # Check PNG signature
    if data[:8] != b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n':
        print(f'{path}: Not a valid PNG')
        return
    
    pos = 8
    while pos < len(data):
        length = struct.unpack('>I', data[pos:pos+4])[0]
        chunk_type = data[pos+4:pos+8]
        pos += 8
        chunk_data = data[pos:pos+length]
        pos += length
        crc = data[pos:pos+4]
        pos += 4
        
        if chunk_type == b'IHDR':
            width = struct.unpack('>I', chunk_data[0:4])[0]
            height = struct.unpack('>I', chunk_data[4:8])[0]
            bit_depth = chunk_data[8]
            color_type = chunk_data[9]
            print(f'{path}: {width}x{height}, bit_depth={bit_depth}, color_type={color_type}')
            break
        elif chunk_type == b'IEND':
            break

for f in ['A-101.png', 'A-301.png', 'A-601.png', 'A-602.png', 'E-101.png', 'F-101.png', 'M-101.png']:
    read_png_info(f'input/{f}')
"

def read_png_pixels(path):
    with open(path, 'rb') as f:
        data = f.read()
    
    if data[:8] != b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n':
        return None
    
    pos = 8
    idat_chunks = []
    while pos < len(data):
        length = struct.unpack('>I', data[pos:pos+4])[0]
        chunk_type = data[pos+4:pos+8]
        pos += 8
        chunk_data = data[pos:pos+length]
        pos += length
        crc = data[pos:pos+4]
        pos += 4
        
        if chunk_type == b'IHDR':
            width = struct.unpack('>I', chunk_data[0:4])[0]
            height = struct.unpack('>I', chunk_data[4:8])[0]
            bit_depth = chunk_data[8]
            color_type = chunk_data[9]
        elif chunk_type == b'IDAT':
            idat_chunks.append(chunk_data)
        elif chunk_type == b'IEND':
            break
    
    compressed = b''.join(idat_chunks)
    decompressed = zlib.decompress(compressed)
    
    # PNG uses filter per scanline
    bytes_per_pixel = 4  # color_type 6 = RGBA
    stride = width * bytes_per_pixel + 1  # +1 for filter byte
    pixels = []
    for y in range(height):
        line = decompressed[y*stride:(y+1)*stride]
        filter_type = line[0]
        line_data = line[1:]
        pixels.append(line_data)
    
    return width, height, pixels

# ============================================================
# GEOMETRY HELPERS
# ============================================================

def create_extrusion(model, profile_pts: List[Tuple[float, float]], depth: float, 
                     position: Tuple[float, float, float] = (0, 0, 0),
                     rotation: Tuple[float, float, float] = (0, 0, 0)) -> ifcopenshell.entity_instance:
    """Create an IfcExtrudedAreaSolid from 2D profile points (in mm)."""
    # Convert mm to m for IFC
    pts_m = [(x/1000.0, y/1000.0) for x, y in profile_pts]
    depth_m = depth / 1000.0
    pos_m = (position[0]/1000.0, position[1]/1000.0, position[2]/1000.0)
    
    # Create polyline
    points = [model.createIfcCartesianPoint((x, y)) for x, y in pts_m]
    polyline = model.createIfcPolyline(points)
    profile = model.createIfcArbitraryClosedProfileDef("AREA", None, polyline)
    
    # Extrusion direction
    dir_z = model.createIfcDirection((0.0, 0.0, 1.0))
    extrusion = model.createIfcExtrudedAreaSolid(profile, None, dir_z, depth_m)
    
    # Placement
    loc = model.createIfcCartesianPoint(pos_m)
    axis = model.createIfcDirection((0.0, 0.0, 1.0))
    ref = model.createIfcDirection((1.0, 0.0, 0.0))
    placement = model.createIfcAxis2Placement3D(loc, axis, ref)
    extrusion.Position = placement
    
    return extrusion


def create_rectangular_extrusion(model, width: float, height: float, depth: float,
                                  position: Tuple[float, float, float] = (0, 0, 0)) -> ifcopenshell.entity_instance:
    """Create a rectangular extrusion."""
    pts = [(0, 0), (width, 0), (width, height), (0, height)]
    return create_extrusion(model, pts, depth, position)


def create_circular_extrusion(model, radius: float, depth: float,
                               position: Tuple[float, float, float] = (0, 0, 0)) -> ifcopenshell.entity_instance:
    """Create a circular extrusion (pipe)."""
    radius_m = radius / 1000.0
    depth_m = depth / 1000.0
    pos_m = (position[0]/1000.0, position[1]/1000.0, position[2]/1000.0)
    
    circle = model.createIfcCircle(model.createIfcAxis2Placement2D(
        model.createIfcCartesianPoint((0.0, 0.0))), radius_m)
    profile = model.createIfcArbitraryClosedProfileDef("AREA", None, circle)
    
    dir_z = model.createIfcDirection((0.0, 0.0, 1.0))
    extrusion = model.createIfcExtrudedAreaSolid(profile, None, dir_z, depth_m)
    
    loc = model.createIfcCartesianPoint(pos_m)
    axis = model.createIfcDirection((0.0, 0.0, 1.0))
    ref = model.createIfcDirection((1.0, 0.0, 0.0))
    placement = model.createIfcAxis2Placement3D(loc, axis, ref)
    extrusion.Position = placement
    
    return extrusion


def create_local_placement(model, location: Tuple[float, float, float],
                           axis: Tuple[float, float, float] = (0, 0, 1),
                           ref: Tuple[float, float, float] = (1, 0, 0),
                           relative_to=None) -> ifcopenshell.entity_instance:
    """Create an IfcLocalPlacement."""
    loc_m = (location[0]/1000.0, location[1]/1000.0, location[2]/1000.0)
    loc = model.createIfcCartesianPoint(loc_m)
    axis_dir = model.createIfcDirection(axis)
    ref_dir = model.createIfcDirection(ref)
    placement = model.createIfcAxis2Placement3D(loc, axis_dir, ref_dir)
    return model.createIfcLocalPlacement(relative_to, placement)


def create_product(model, element_class: str, name: str, object_type: str,
                   geometry: ifcopenshell.entity_instance,
                   placement: ifcopenshell.entity_instance,
                   representation_context) -> ifcopenshell.entity_instance:
    """Create a product with geometry."""
    # Create shape representation
    shape_repr = model.createIfcShapeRepresentation(
        representation_context,
        "Body",
        "SweptSolid",
        [geometry]
    )
    
    # Product definition shape
    prod_shape = model.createIfcProductDefinitionShape(None, None, [shape_repr])
    
    # Create element
    if element_class == "IfcColumn":
        element = model.createIfcColumn(
            ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, name, None, None,
            placement, prod_shape, None
        )
    elif element_class == "IfcFurniture":
        element = model.createIfcFurniture(
            ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, name, None, None,
            placement, prod_shape, None, object_type
        )
    elif element_class == "IfcFlowSegment":
        element = model.createIfcFlowSegment(
            ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, name, None, None,
            placement, prod_shape, None
        )
    elif element_class == "IfcCableCarrierSegment":
        element = model.createIfcCableCarrierSegment(
            ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, name, None, None,
            placement, prod_shape, None
        )
    elif element_class == "IfcBuildingElementProxy":
        element = model.createIfcBuildingElementProxy(
            ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, name, None, None,
            placement, prod_shape, None, object_type
        )
    elif element_class == "IfcFlowTerminal":
        element = model.createIfcFlowTerminal(
            ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, name, None, None,
            placement, prod_shape, None
        )
    else:
        element = model.createIfcBuildingElementProxy(
            ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, name, None, None,
            placement, prod_shape, None, object_type
        )
    
    return element


def add_property_set(model, element, pset_name: str, properties: Dict[str, Any]):
    """Add a property set to an element."""
    pset_props = []
    for key, value in properties.items():
        if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
            prop = model.createIfcPropertySingleValue(key, None, 
                model.createIfcReal(value) if isinstance(value, float) else model.createIfcInteger(value), None)
        elif isinstance(value, str):
            prop = model.createIfcPropertySingleValue(key, None, model.createIfcLabel(value), None)
        elif isinstance(value, bool):
            prop = model.createIfcPropertySingleValue(key, None, model.createIfcBoolean(value), None)
        else:
            prop = model.createIfcPropertySingleValue(key, None, model.createIfcLabel(str(value)), None)
        pset_props.append(prop)
    
    pset = model.createIfcPropertySet(ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, pset_name, None, pset_props)
    rel = model.createIfcRelDefinesByProperties(ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, None, None, [element], pset)
    return pset


# ============================================================
# MAIN MODEL BUILDING
# ============================================================

def build_model() -> ifcopenshell.file:
    model = ifcopenshell.file(schema="IFC4")
    
    # ---- Project setup ----
    project = model.createIfcProject(
        ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, "DC_Model_Hall_Seed005_D100", 
        None, None, None, None, None
    )
    
    # Units (mm)
    units = ifcopenshell.api.run("unit.assign_unit", model, 
        length={"is_metric": True, "raw": "MILLIMETRE"})
    
    # Context
    context = model.createIfcGeometricRepresentationContext(
        None, "Model", 3, 1.0e-5, 
        model.createIfcAxis2Placement3D(
            model.createIfcCartesianPoint((0.0, 0.0, 0.0)),
            model.createIfcDirection((0.0, 0.0, 1.0)),
            model.createIfcDirection((1.0, 0.0, 0.0))
        )
    )
    body_context = model.createIfcGeometricRepresentationSubContext(
        context, "Model", "Body", "MODEL_VIEW", None
    )
    
    # Spatial structure
    site = model.createIfcSite(ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, "Site", None, None,
        create_local_placement(model, (0, 0, 0)), None, None, "ELEMENT")
    building = model.createIfcBuilding(ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, "DataHall", None, None,
        create_local_placement(model, (0, 0, 0), relative_to=site), None, None, "ELEMENT")
    storey = model.createIfcBuildingStorey(ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, "GroundFloor", None, None,
        create_local_placement(model, (0, 0, 0), relative_to=building), None, "ELEMENT", 0.0)
    
    # Aggregate relationships
    model.createIfcRelAggregates(ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, None, None, project, [site])
    model.createIfcRelAggregates(ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, None, None, site, [building])
    model.createIfcRelAggregates(ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, None, None, building, [storey])
    
    # Containment
    def contain(elements):
        model.createIfcRelContainedInSpatialStructure(
            ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, None, None, elements, storey
        )
    
    # ============================================================
    # 1. STRUCTURAL COLUMNS (7200mm grid)
    # ============================================================
    columns = []
    # Grid covers room: 27000/7200 = 3.75 -> 4 bays in X, 24000/7200 = 3.33 -> 4 bays in Y
    # Columns at grid intersections
    num_grid_x = int(ROOM_WIDTH / GRID_SPACING) + 1  # 4
    num_grid_y = int(ROOM_DEPTH / GRID_SPACING) + 1  # 4
    
    for ix in range(num_grid_x):

                add_property_set(model, col, "Pset_DCM_Column", {
                    "GridX": ix, "GridY": iy, "GridSpacing": GRID_SPACING,
                    "Size": COLUMN_SIZE, "Height": ROOM_HEIGHT
                })
                columns.append(col)
    
    contain(columns)
    print(f"Created {len(columns)} columns")

    # ============================================================
    # Floor tile grid starts at -GRID_OFFSET from structural grid
    tile_start_x = -GRID_OFFSET
    tile_start_y = -GRID_OFFSET
    # But room starts at 0, so first tile at max(0, tile_start_x rounded to tile)
    first_tile_x = 0

def create_extrusion(model, profile_pts: List[Tuple[float, float]], depth: float, 
                     position: Tuple[float, float, float] = (0, 0, 0),
                     rotation: Tuple[float, float, float] = (0, 0, 0)) -> ifcopenshell.entity_instance:
    """Create an IfcExtrudedAreaSolid from 2D profile points (in mm)."""
    # Convert mm to m for IFC
    pts_m = [(x/1000.0, y/1000.0) for x, y in profile_pts]
    depth_m = depth / 1000.0
    pos_m = (position[0]/1000.0, position[1]/1000.0, position[2]/1000.0)
    
    # Create polyline
    points = [model.createIfcCartesianPoint((x, y)) for x, y in pts_m]
    polyline = model.createIfcPolyline(points)
    profile = model.createIfcArbitraryClosedProfileDef("AREA", None, polyline)
    
    # Extrusion direction
    dir_z = model.createIfcDirection((0.0, 0.0, 1.0))
    extrusion = model.createIfcExtrudedAreaSolid(profile, None, dir_z, depth_m)
    
    # Placement
    loc = model.createIfcCartesianPoint(pos_m)
    axis = model.createIfcDirection((0.0, 0.0, 1.0))
    ref = model.createIfcDirection((1.0, 0.0, 0.0))
    placement = model.createIfcAxis2Placement3D(loc, axis, ref)
    extrusion.Position = placement
    
    return extrusion


def create_rectangular_extrusion(model, width: float, height: float, depth: float,
                                  position: Tuple[float, float, float] = (0, 0, 0)) -> ifcopenshell.entity_instance:
    """Create a rectangular extrusion."""
    pts = [(0, 0), (width, 0), (width, height), (0, height)]
    return create_extrusion(model, pts, depth, position)


def create_circular_extrusion(model, radius: float, depth: float,
                               position: Tuple[float, float, float] = (0, 0, 0)) -> ifcopenshell.entity_instance:
    """Create a circular extrusion (pipe)."""
    radius_m = radius / 1000.0
    depth_m = depth / 1000.0
    pos_m = (position[0]/1000.0, position[1]/1000.0, position[2]/1000.0)
    
    circle = model.createIfcCircle(model.createIfcAxis2Placement2D(
        model.createIfcCartesianPoint((0.0, 0.0))), radius_m)
    profile = model.createIfcArbitraryClosedProfileDef("AREA", None, circle)
    
    dir_z = model.createIfcDirection((0.0, 0.0, 1.0))
    extrusion = model.createIfcExtrudedAreaSolid(profile, None, dir_z, depth_m)
    
    loc = model.createIfcCartesianPoint(pos_m)
    axis = model.createIfcDirection((0.0, 0.0, 1.0))
    ref = model.createIfcDirection((1.0, 0.0, 0.0))
    placement = model.createIfcAxis2Placement3D(loc, axis, ref)
    extrusion.Position = placement
    
    return extrusion


def create_local_placement(model, location: Tuple[float, float, float],
                           axis: Tuple[float, float, float] = (0, 0, 1),
                           ref: Tuple[float, float, float] = (1, 0, 0),
                           relative_to=None) -> ifcopenshell.entity_instance:
    """Create an IfcLocalPlacement."""
    loc_m = (location[0]/1000.0, location[1]/1000.0, location[2]/1000.0)
    loc = model.createIfcCartesianPoint(loc_m)
    axis_dir = model.createIfcDirection(axis)
    ref_dir = model.createIfcDirection(ref)
    placement = model.createIfcAxis2Placement3D(loc, axis_dir, ref_dir)
    return model.createIfcLocalPlacement(relative_to, placement)

                   geometry: ifcopenshell.entity_instance,
                   placement: ifcopenshell.entity_instance,
                   representation_context) -> ifcopenshell.entity_instance:
    """Create a product with geometry."""
    # Create shape representation

        representation_context,
        "Body",
        "SweptSolid",
        [geometry]
    )
    
    # Product definition shape

        element = model.createIfcColumn(
            ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, name, None, None,
            placement, prod_shape, None
        )
    elif element_class == "IfcFurniture":
        element = model.createIfcFurniture(
            ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, name, None, None,
            placement, prod_shape, None, object_type
        )
    elif element_class == "IfcFlowSegment":

            ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, name, None, None,

        )

def add_property_set(model, element, pset_name: str, properties: Dict[str, Any]):
    """Add a property set to an element."""
    pset_props = []
    for key, value in properties.items():
        if isinstance(value, (int, float)):

                model.createIfcReal(value) if isinstance(value, float) else model.createIfcInteger(value), None)

"""

Builds a coordinated IFC4 model with clash-free overhead services.
"""

import sys

import ifcopenshell
import ifcopenshell.api
import ifcopenshell.util.element
import ifcopenshell.util.placement
import numpy as np
from typing import List, Tuple, Dict, Any, Optional

# ============================================================
# BAKED DRAWING DATA (from task description & PNG analysis)
# ============================================================

# Room dimensions (mm)

CABINET_DEPTH = 1200  # mm

# Sprinklers
NUM_SPRINKLERS = 104

# Clearances (mm)

SPRINKLER_CLEARANCE = 460      # Below deflector
NFPA13_OBSTRUCTION_ZONE = 450  # Below deflector
TRAY_BUSWAY_SEPARATION = 300   # On at least one axis
NO_CHW_ABOVE_PDU_HEIGHT = 1800 # Dedicated space above PDU
PIPE_INSULATION = 25.4         # mm

# Service routing
BUSWAY_SUPPORT_SPACING = 1500  # mm max

# Elevation bands (mm above FFL)
CEILING_HEIGHT = 4500  # Assumed ceiling
PLENUM_TOP = CEILING_HEIGHT
CLEAR_HEIGHT_LIMIT = MIN_HEADROOM  # 2600mm minimum clear

# Service elevations (mm above FFL) - in the clear height band
TRAY_ELEVATION = 2800      # Cable tray bottom
BUSWAY_ELEVATION = 3100    # Busway bottom
CHW_ELEVATION = 3400       # CHW pipe centerline (insulated)

# Service sizes (mm)
TRAY_WIDTH = 300
TRAY_HEIGHT = 100
BUSWAY_WIDTH = 200
BUSWAY_HEIGHT = 150
CHW_PIPE_OD = 100  # Nominal 100mm pipe
CHW_INSULATED_OD = CHW_PIPE_OD + 2 * PIPE_INSULATION  # 150.8mm

# Column size
COLUMN_SIZE = 400  # mm square

# PDU dimensions
PDU_WIDTH = 600
PDU_DEPTH = 300
PDU_HEIGHT = 2000

# CRAH dimensions
CRAH_WIDTH = 1200
CRAH_DEPTH = 1200
CRAH_HEIGHT = 2500

# Sprinkler grid spacing (to get 104 heads in 27x24m)
# ~104 heads = 13 x 8 grid approximately
SPRINKLER_SPACING_X = 27000 / 13  # ~2077mm
SPRINKLER_SPACING_Y = 24000 / 8   # 3000mm

# ============================================================
# GEOMETRY HELPERS
# ============================================================

def create_extrusion(model, profile_pts: List[Tuple[float, float]], depth: float, 
                     position: Tuple[float, float, float] = (0, 0, 0),
                     rotation: Tuple[float, float, float] = (0, 0, 0)) -> ifcopenshell.entity_instance:
    """Create an IfcExtrudedAreaSolid from 2D profile points (in mm)."""
    # Convert mm to m for IFC
    pts_m = [(x/1000.0, y/1000.0) for x, y in profile_pts]
    depth_m = depth / 1000.0
    pos_m = (position[0]/1000.0, position[1]/1000.0, position[2]/1000.0)
    
    # Create polyline
    points = [model.createIfcCartesianPoint((x, y)) for x, y in pts_m]
    polyline = model.createIfcPolyline(points)
    profile = model.createIfcArbitraryClosedProfileDef("AREA", None, polyline)
    
    # Extrusion direction
    dir_z = model.createIfcDirection((0.0, 0.0, 1.0))
    extrusion = model.createIfcExtrudedAreaSolid(profile, None, dir_z, depth_m)
    
    # Placement
    loc = model.createIfcCartesianPoint(pos_m)
    axis = model.createIfcDirection((0.0, 0.0, 1.0))
    ref = model.createIfcDirection((1.0, 0.0, 0.0))
    placement = model.createIfcAxis2Placement3D(loc, axis, ref)
    extrusion.Position = placement
    
    return extrusion


def create_rectangular_extrusion(model, width: float, height: float, depth: float,
                                  position: Tuple[float, float, float] = (0, 0, 0)) -> ifcopenshell.entity_instance:
    """Create a rectangular extrusion."""
    pts = [(0, 0), (width, 0), (width, height), (0, height)]
    return create_extrusion(model, pts, depth, position)


def create_circular_extrusion(model, radius: float, depth: float,
                               position: Tuple[float, float, float] = (0, 0, 0)) -> ifcopenshell.entity_instance:
    """Create a circular extrusion (pipe)."""
    radius_m = radius / 1000.0
    depth_m = depth / 1000.0
    pos_m = (position[0]/1000.0, position[1]/1000.0, position[2]/1000.0)
    
    circle = model.createIfcCircle(model.createIfcAxis2Placement2D(
        model.createIfcCartesianPoint((0.0, 0.0))), radius_m)
    profile = model.createIfcArbitraryClosedProfileDef("AREA", None, circle)
    
    dir_z = model.createIfcDirection((0.0, 0.0, 1.0))
    extrusion = model.createIfcExtrudedAreaSolid(profile, None, dir_z, depth_m)
    
    loc = model.createIfcCartesianPoint(pos_m)
    axis = model.createIfcDirection((0.0, 0.0, 1.0))
    ref = model.createIfcDirection((1.0, 0.0, 0.0))
    placement = model.createIfcAxis2Placement3D(loc, axis, ref)
    extrusion.Position = placement
    
    return extrusion


def create_local_placement(model, location: Tuple[float, float, float],
                           axis: Tuple[float, float, float] = (0, 0, 1),
                           ref: Tuple[float, float, float] = (1, 0, 0),
                           relative_to=None) -> ifcopenshell.entity_instance:
    """Create an IfcLocalPlacement."""
    loc_m = (location[0]/1000.0, location[1]/1000.0, location[2]/1000.0)
    loc = model.createIfcCartesianPoint(loc_m)
    axis_dir = model.createIfcDirection(axis)
    ref_dir = model.createIfcDirection(ref)
    placement = model.createIfcAxis2Placement3D(loc, axis_dir, ref_dir)
    return model.createIfcLocalPlacement(relative_to, placement)


def create_product(model, element_class: str, name: str, object_type: str,
                   geometry: ifcopenshell.entity_instance,
                   placement: ifcopenshell.entity_instance,
                   representation_context) -> ifcopenshell.entity_instance:
    """Create a product with geometry."""
    # Create shape representation
    shape_repr = model.createIfcShapeRepresentation(
        representation_context,
        "Body",
        "SweptSolid",
        [geometry]
    )
    
    # Product definition shape
    prod_shape = model.createIfcProductDefinitionShape(None, None, [shape_repr])
    
    # Create element
    if element_class == "IfcColumn":
        element = model.createIfcColumn(
            ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, name, None, None,
            placement, prod_shape, None
        )
    elif element_class == "IfcFurniture":
        element = model.createIfcFurniture(
            ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, name, None, None,
            placement, prod_shape, None, object_type
        )
    elif element_class == "IfcFlowSegment":
        element = model.createIfcFlowSegment(
            ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, name, None, None,
            placement, prod_shape, None
        )
    elif element_class == "IfcCableCarrierSegment":
        element = model.createIfcCableCarrierSegment(
            ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, name, None, None,
            placement, prod_shape, None
        )
    elif element_class == "IfcBuildingElementProxy":
        element = model.createIfcBuildingElementProxy(
            ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, name, None, None,
            placement, prod_shape, None, object_type
        )
    elif element_class == "IfcFlowTerminal":
        element = model.createIfcFlowTerminal(
            ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, name, None, None,
            placement, prod_shape, None
        )
    else:
        element = model.createIfcBuildingElementProxy(
            ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, name, None, None,
            placement, prod_shape, None, object_type
        )
    
    return element


def add_property_set(model, element, pset_name: str, properties: Dict[str, Any]):
    """Add a property set to an element."""
    pset_props = []
    for key, value in properties.items():
        if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
            prop = model.createIfcPropertySingleValue(key, None, 
                model.createIfcReal(value) if isinstance(value, float) else model.createIfcInteger(value), None)
        elif isinstance(value, str):
            prop = model.createIfcPropertySingleValue(key, None, model.createIfcLabel(value), None)
        elif isinstance(value, bool):
            prop = model.createIfcPropertySingleValue(key, None, model.createIfcBoolean(value), None)
        else:
            prop = model.createIfcPropertySingleValue(key, None, model.createIfcLabel(str(value)), None)
        pset_props.append(prop)
    
    pset = model.createIfcPropertySet(ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, pset_name, None, pset_props)
    rel = model.createIfcRelDefinesByProperties(ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, None, None, [element], pset)
    return pset


# ============================================================
# MAIN MODEL BUILDING
# ============================================================

def build_model() -> ifcopenshell.file:
    model = ifcopenshell.file(schema="IFC4")
    
    # ---- Project setup ----
    project = model.createIfcProject(
        ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, "DC_Model_Hall_Seed005_D100", 
        None, None, None, None, None
    )
    
    # Units (mm)
    unit_length = model.createIfcSIUnit(None, "LENGTHUNIT", "MILLI", model.createIfcUnitEnum("METRE"))
    model.createIfcUnitAssignment([unit_length])
    
    # Context
    context = model.createIfcGeometricRepresentationContext(
        None, "Model", 3, 1.0e-5, 
        model.createIfcAxis2Placement3D(
            model.createIfcCartesianPoint((0.0, 0.0, 0.0)),
            model.createIfcDirection((0.0, 0.0, 1.0)),
            model.createIfcDirection((1.0, 0.0, 0.0))
        )
    )
    body_context = model.createIfcGeometricRepresentationSubContext(
        context, "Model", "Body", "MODEL_VIEW", None
    )
    
    # Spatial structure
    site = model.createIfcSite(ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, "Site", None, None,
        create_local_placement(model, (0, 0, 0)), None, None, "ELEMENT")
    building = model.createIfcBuilding(ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, "DataHall", None, None,
        create_local_placement(model, (0, 0, 0), relative_to=site), None, None, "ELEMENT")
    storey = model.createIfcBuildingStorey(ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, "GroundFloor", None, None,
        create_local_placement(model, (0, 0, 0), relative_to=building), None, "ELEMENT", 0.0)
    
    # Aggregate relationships
    model.createIfcRelAggregates(ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, None, None, project, [site])
    model.createIfcRelAggregates(ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, None, None, site, [building])
    model.createIfcRelAggregates(ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, None, None, building, [storey])
    
    # Containment
    def contain(elements):
        model.createIfcRelContainedInSpatialStructure(
            ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, None, None, elements, storey
        )
    
    # ============================================================
    # 1. STRUCTURAL COLUMNS (7200mm grid)
    # ============================================================
    columns = []
    # Grid covers room: 27000/7200 = 3.75 -> 4 bays in X, 24000/7200 = 3.33 -> 4 bays in Y
    # Columns at grid intersections
    num_grid_x = int(ROOM_WIDTH / GRID_SPACING) + 1  # 4
    num_grid_y = int(ROOM_DEPTH / GRID_SPACING) + 1  # 4
    
    for ix in range(num_grid_x):
        for iy in range(num_grid_y):
            x = ix * GRID_SPACING
            y = iy * GRID_SPACING
            # Only place columns inside or at room boundary
            if 0 <= x <= ROOM_WIDTH and 0 <= y <= ROOM_DEPTH:
                col = create_product(
                    model, "IfcColumn", f"Column_{ix}_{iy}", "Structural",
                    create_rectangular_extrusion(model, COLUMN_SIZE, COLUMN_SIZE, ROOM_HEIGHT, 
                                                  (x - COLUMN_SIZE/2, y - COLUMN_SIZE/2, FFL)),
                    create_local_placement(model, (0, 0, 0)),
                    body_context
                )
                add_property_set(model, col, "Pset_DCM_Column", {
                    "GridX": ix, "GridY": iy, "GridSpacing": GRID_SPACING,
                    "Size": COLUMN_SIZE, "Height": ROOM_HEIGHT
                })
                columns.append(col)
    
    contain(columns)
    print(f"Created {len(columns)} columns")
    
    # ============================================================
    # 2. FLOOR TILES & ACCESS FLOOR (600mm grid, offset 150mm from structural)
    # ============================================================
    # Floor tile grid starts at -GRID_OFFSET from structural grid
    tile_start_x = -GRID_OFFSET
    tile_start_y = -GRID_OFFSET
    # But room starts at 0, so first tile at max(0, tile_start_x rounded to tile)
    first_tile_x = 0
    first_tile_y = 0
    num_tiles_x = int(ROOM_WIDTH / TILE_SIZE) + 1
    num_tiles_y = int(ROOM_DEPTH / TILE_SIZE) + 1
    
    # Access floor pedestals (simplified - just the floor slab)
    floor_slab = create_product(
        model, "IfcSlab", "AccessFloor", "RaisedFloor",
        create_rectangular_extrusion(model, ROOM_WIDTH, ROOM_DEPTH, 50, (0, 0, -50)),
        create_local_placement(model, (0, 0, 0)),
        body_context
    )
    add_property_set(model, floor_slab, "Pset_DCM_AccessFloor", {
        "TileSize": TILE_SIZE, "GridOffset": GRID_OFFSET, "PedestalHeight": 500
    })
    contain([floor_slab])
    
    # ============================================================
    # 3. CABINET ROWS (94 cabinets)
    # ============================================================
    # Layout: Cross-aisle re-registers rows
    # Room 27m x 24m, cabinets 600x1200
    # Typical: rows along X (27m) or Y (24m)
    # With cross-aisle at mid-depth (12m)
    
    cabinets = []
    cabinet_id = 0
    
    # Row layout: Two row groups separated by cross-aisle at y=12000

def create_extrusion(model, profile_pts: List[Tuple[float, float]], depth: float, 
                     position: Tuple[float, float, float] = (0, 0, 0),
                     rotation: Tuple[float, float, float] = (0, 0, 0)) -> ifcopenshell.entity_instance:
    """Create an IfcExtrudedAreaSolid from 2D profile points (in mm)."""
    # Convert mm to m for IFC
    pts_m = [(x/1000.0, y/1000.0) for x, y in profile_pts]
    depth_m = depth / 1000.0
    pos_m = (position[0]/1000.0, position[1]/1000.0, position[2]/1000.0)
    
    # Create polyline
    points = [model.createIfcCartesianPoint((x, y)) for x, y in pts_m]
    polyline = model.createIfcPolyline(points)
    profile = model.createIfcArbitraryClosedProfileDef("AREA", None, polyline)
    
    # Extrusion direction
    dir_z = model.createIfcDirection((0.0, 0.0, 1.0))
    extrusion = model.createIfcExtrudedAreaSolid(profile, None, dir_z, depth_m)
    
    # Placement
    loc = model.createIfcCartesianPoint(pos_m)
    axis = model.createIfcDirection((0.0, 0.0, 1.0))
    ref = model.createIfcDirection((1.0, 0.0, 0.0))
    placement = model.createIfcAxis2Placement3D(loc, axis, ref)
    extrusion.Position = placement
    
    return extrusion


def create_rectangular_extrusion(model, width: float, height: float, depth: float,
                                  position: Tuple[float, float, float] = (0, 0, 0)) -> ifcopenshell.entity_instance:
    """Create a rectangular extrusion."""
    pts = [(0, 0), (width, 0), (width, height), (0, height)]
    return create_extrusion(model, pts, depth, position)


def create_circular_extrusion(model, radius: float, depth: float,
                               position: Tuple[float, float, float] = (0, 0, 0)) -> ifcopenshell.entity_instance:
    """Create a circular extrusion (pipe)."""
    radius_m = radius / 1000.0
    depth_m = depth / 1000.0
    pos_m = (position[0]/1000.0, position[1]/1000.0, position[2]/1000.0)
    
    circle = model.createIfcCircle(model.createIfcAxis2Placement2D(
        model.createIfcCartesianPoint((0.0, 0.0))), radius_m)
    profile = model.createIfcArbitraryClosedProfileDef("AREA", None, circle)
    
    dir_z = model.createIfcDirection((0.0, 0.0, 1.0))
    extrusion = model.createIfcExtrudedAreaSolid(profile, None, dir_z, depth_m)
    
    loc = model.createIfcCartesianPoint(pos_m)
    axis = model.createIfcDirection((0.0, 0.0, 1.0))
    ref = model.createIfcDirection((1.0, 0.0, 0.0))
    placement = model.createIfcAxis2Placement3D(loc, axis, ref)
    extrusion.Position = placement
    
    return extrusion


def create_local_placement(model, location: Tuple[float, float, float],
                           axis: Tuple[float, float, float] = (0, 0, 1),
                           ref: Tuple[float, float, float] = (1, 0, 0),
                           relative_to=None) -> ifcopenshell.entity_instance:
    """Create an IfcLocalPlacement."""
    loc_m = (location[0]/1000.0, location[1]/1000.0, location[2]/1000.0)
    loc = model.createIfcCartesianPoint(loc_m)
    axis_dir = model.createIfcDirection(axis)
    ref_dir = model.createIfcDirection(ref)
    placement = model.createIfcAxis2Placement3D(loc, axis_dir, ref_dir)
    return model.createIfcLocalPlacement(relative_to, placement)

                   geometry: ifcopenshell.entity_instance,

    pset_props = []
    for key, value in properties.items():

from typing import List, Tuple, Dict, Any, Optional

# ============================================================

# Room dimensions (mm)

# Service routing
BUSWAY_SUPPORT_SPACING = 1500  # mm max

PLENUM_TOP = CEILING_HEIGHT
CLEAR_HEIGHT_LIMIT = MIN_HEADROOM  # 2600mm minimum clear

# Service elevations (mm above FFL) - in the clear height band
TRAY_ELEVATION = 2800      # Cable tray bottom
BUSWAY_ELEVATION = 3100    # Busway bottom
CHW_ELEVATION = 3400       # CHW pipe centerline (insulated)

# Service sizes (mm)
TRAY_WIDTH = 300
TRAY_HEIGHT = 100
BUSWAY_WIDTH = 200
BUSWAY_HEIGHT = 150
CHW_PIPE_OD = 100  # Nominal 100mm pipe
CHW_INSULATED_OD = CHW_PIPE_OD + 2 * PIPE_INSULATION  # 150.8mm

# Column size
COLUMN_SIZE = 400  # mm square

# PDU dimensions
PDU_WIDTH = 600
PDU_DEPTH = 300
PDU_HEIGHT = 2000

# CRAH dimensions
CRAH_WIDTH = 1200
CRAH_DEPTH = 1200
CRAH_HEIGHT = 2500

# Sprinkler grid spacing (to get 104 heads in 27x24m)
# ~104 heads = 13 x 8 grid approximately
SPRINKLER_SPACING_X = 27000 / 13  # ~2077mm
SPRINKLER_SPACING_Y = 24000 / 8   # 3000mm

# ============================================================
# GEOMETRY HELPERS
# ============================================================

def create_extrusion(model, profile_pts: List[Tuple[float, float]], depth: float, 
                     position: Tuple[float, float, float] = (0, 0, 0),
                     rotation: Tuple[float, float, float] = (0, 0, 0)) -> ifcopenshell.entity_instance:
    """Create an IfcExtrudedAreaSolid from 2D profile points (in mm)."""
    # Convert mm to m for IFC
    pts_m = [(x/1000.0, y/1000.0) for x, y in profile_pts]
    depth_m = depth / 1000.0
    pos_m = (position[0]/1000.0, position[1]/1000.0, position[2]/1000.0)
    
    # Create polyline
    points = [model.createIfcCartesianPoint((x, y)) for x, y in pts_m]
    polyline = model.createIfcPolyline(points)
    profile = model.createIfcArbitraryClosedProfileDef("AREA", None, polyline)
    
    # Extrusion direction
    dir_z = model.createIfcDirection((0.0, 0.0, 1.0))
    extrusion = model.createIfcExtrudedAreaSolid(profile, None, dir_z, depth_m)
    
    # Placement
    loc = model.createIfcCartesianPoint(pos_m)
    axis = model.createIfcDirection((0.0, 0.0, 1.0))
    ref = model.createIfcDirection((1.0, 0.0, 0.0))
    placement = model.createIfcAxis2Placement3D(loc, axis, ref)
    extrusion.Position = placement
    
    return extrusion


def create_rectangular_extrusion(model, width: float, height: float, depth: float,
                                  position: Tuple[float, float, float] = (0, 0, 0)) -> ifcopenshell.entity_instance:
    """Create a rectangular extrusion."""
    pts = [(0, 0), (width, 0), (width, height), (0, height)]
    return create_extrusion(model, pts, depth, position)


def create_circular_extrusion(model, radius: float, depth: float,
                               position: Tuple[float, float, float] = (0, 0, 0)) -> ifcopenshell.entity_instance:
    """Create a circular extrusion (pipe)."""
    radius_m = radius / 1000.0
    depth_m = depth / 1000.0
    pos_m = (position[0]/1000.0, position[1]/1000.0, position[2]/1000.0)
    
    circle = model.createIfcCircle(model.createIfcAxis2Placement2D(
        model.createIfcCartesianPoint((0.0, 0.0))), radius_m)
    profile = model.createIfcArbitraryClosedProfileDef("AREA", None, circle)
    
    dir_z = model.createIfcDirection((0.0, 0.0, 1.0))
    extrusion = model.createIfcExtrudedAreaSolid(profile, None, dir_z, depth_m)
    
    loc = model.createIfcCartesianPoint(pos_m)
    axis = model.createIfcDirection((0.0, 0.0, 1.0))
    ref = model.createIfcDirection((1.0, 0.0, 0.0))
    placement = model.createIfcAxis2Placement3D(loc, axis, ref)
    extrusion.Position = placement
    
    return extrusion


def create_local_placement(model, location: Tuple[float, float, float],
                           axis: Tuple[float, float, float] = (0, 0, 1),
                           ref: Tuple[float, float, float] = (1, 0, 0),
                           relative_to=None) -> ifcopenshell.entity_instance:
    """Create an IfcLocalPlacement."""
    loc_m = (location[0]/1000.0, location[1]/1000.0, location[2]/1000.0)
    loc = model.createIfcCartesianPoint(loc_m)
    axis_dir = model.createIfcDirection(axis)
    ref_dir = model.createIfcDirection(ref)
    placement = model.createIfcAxis2Placement3D(loc, axis_dir, ref_dir)
    return model.createIfcLocalPlacement(relative_to, placement)


def create_product(model, element_class: str, name: str, object_type: str,
                   geometry: ifcopenshell.entity_instance,
                   placement: ifcopenshell.entity_instance,
                   representation_context) -> ifcopenshell.entity_instance:
    """Create a product with geometry."""
    # Create shape representation
    shape_repr = model.createIfcShapeRepresentation(
        representation_context,
        "Body",
        "SweptSolid",
        [geometry]
    )
    
    # Product definition shape
    prod_shape = model.createIfcProductDefinitionShape(None, None, [shape_repr])
    
    # Create element
    if element_class == "IfcColumn":
        element = model.createIfcColumn(
            ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, name, None, None,
            placement, prod_shape, None
        )
    elif element_class == "IfcFurniture":
        element = model.createIfcFurniture(
            ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, name, None, None,
            placement, prod_shape, None, object_type
        )
    elif element_class == "IfcFlowSegment":
        element = model.createIfcFlowSegment(
            ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, name, None, None,
            placement, prod_shape, None
        )
    elif element_class == "IfcCableCarrierSegment":
        element = model.createIfcCableCarrierSegment(
            ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, name, None, None,
            placement, prod_shape, None
        )
    elif element_class == "IfcBuildingElementProxy":
        element = model.createIfcBuildingElementProxy(
            ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, name, None, None,
            placement, prod_shape, None, object_type
        )
    elif element_class == "IfcFlowTerminal":
        element = model.createIfcFlowTerminal(
            ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, name, None, None,
            placement, prod_shape, None
        )
    else:
        element = model.createIfcBuildingElementProxy(
            ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, name, None, None,
            placement, prod_shape, None, object_type
        )
    
    return element


def add_property_set(model, element, pset_name: str, properties: Dict[str, Any]):
    """Add a property set to an element."""
    pset_props = []
    for key, value in properties.items():
        if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
            prop = model.createIfcPropertySingleValue(key, None, 
                model.createIfcReal(value) if isinstance(value, float) else model.createIfcInteger(value), None)
        elif isinstance(value, str):
            prop = model.createIfcPropertySingleValue(key, None, model.createIfcLabel(value), None)
        elif isinstance(value, bool):
            prop = model.createIfcPropertySingleValue(key, None, model.createIfcBoolean(value), None)
        else:
            prop = model.createIfcPropertySingleValue(key, None, model.createIfcLabel(str(value)), None)
        pset_props.append(prop)
    
    pset = model.createIfcPropertySet(ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, pset_name, None, pset_props)
    rel = model.createIfcRelDefinesByProperties(ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, None, None, [element], pset)
    return pset


# ============================================================

def build_model() -> ifcopenshell.file:
    model = ifcopenshell.file(schema="IFC4")
    
    # ---- Project setup ----
    project = model.createIfcProject(

    )

        )
    )
    body_context = model.createIfcGeometricRepresentationSubContext(
        context, "Model", "Body", "MODEL_VIEW", None
    )
    
    # Spatial structure
    site = model.createIfcSite(ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, "Site", None, None,
        create_local_placement(model, (0, 0, 0)), None, None, "ELEMENT")
    building = model.createIfcBuilding(ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, "DataHall", None, None,
        create_local_placement(model, (0, 0, 0), relative_to=site), None, None, "ELEMENT")
    storey = model.createIfcBuildingStorey(ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, "GroundFloor", None, None,
        create_local_placement(model, (0, 0, 0), relative_to=building), None, "ELEMENT", 0.0)
    
    # Aggregate relationships
    model.createIfcRelAggregates(ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, None, None, project, [site])
    model.createIfcRelAggregates(ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, None, None, site, [building])
    model.createIfcRelAggregates(ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, None, None, building, [storey])
    
    # Containment
    def contain(elements):
        model.createIfcRelContainedInSpatialStructure(
            ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, None, None, elements, storey
        )
    
    # ============================================================
    # 1. STRUCTURAL COLUMNS (7200mm grid)
    # ============================================================
    columns = []
    # Grid covers room: 27000/7200 = 3.75 -> 4 bays in X, 24000/7200 = 3.33 -> 4 bays in Y

# ============================================================

def create_extrusion(model, profile_pts: List[Tuple[float, float]], depth: float, 
                     position: Tuple[float, float, float] = (0, 0, 0),
                     rotation: Tuple[float, float, float] = (0, 0, 0)) -> ifcopenshell.entity_instance:
    """Create an IfcExtrudedAreaSolid from 2D profile points (in mm)."""
    # Convert mm to m for IFC
    pts_m = [(x/1000.0, y/1000.0) for x, y in profile_pts]
    depth_m = depth / 1000.0
    pos_m = (position[0]/1000.0, position[1]/1000.0, position[2]/1000.0)
    
    # Create polyline
    points = [model.createIfcCartesianPoint((x, y)) for x, y in pts_m]
    polyline = model.createIfcPolyline(points)
    profile = model.createIfcArbitraryClosedProfileDef("AREA", None, polyline)
    
    # Extrusion direction
    dir_z = model.createIfcDirection((0.0, 0.0, 1.0))
    extrusion = model.createIfcExtrudedAreaSolid(profile, None, dir_z, depth_m)
    
    # Placement
    loc = model.createIfcCartesianPoint(pos_m)
    axis = model.createIfcDirection((0.0, 0.0, 1.0))
    ref = model.createIfcDirection((1.0, 0.0, 0.0))
    placement = model.createIfcAxis2Placement3D(loc, axis, ref)
    extrusion.Position = placement
    
    return extrusion


def create_rectangular_extrusion(model, width: float, height: float, depth: float,
                                  position: Tuple[float, float, float] = (0, 0, 0)) -> ifcopenshell.entity_instance:
    """Create a rectangular extrusion."""
    pts = [(0, 0), (width, 0), (width, height), (0, height)]
    return create_extrusion(model, pts, depth, position)


def create_circular_extrusion(model, radius: float, depth: float,
                               position: Tuple[float, float, float] = (0, 0, 0)) -> ifcopenshell.entity_instance:
    """Create a circular extrusion (pipe)."""
    radius_m = radius / 1000.0
    depth_m = depth / 1000.0
    pos_m = (position[0]/1000.0, position[1]/1000.0, position[2]/1000.0)
    
    circle = model.createIfcCircle(model.createIfcAxis2Placement2D(
        model.createIfcCartesianPoint((0.0, 0.0))), radius_m)
    profile = model.createIfcArbitraryClosedProfileDef("AREA", None, circle)
    
    dir_z = model.createIfcDirection((0.0, 0.0, 1.0))
    extrusion = model.createIfcExtrudedAreaSolid(profile, None, dir_z, depth_m)
    
    loc = model.createIfcCartesianPoint(pos_m)
    axis = model.createIfcDirection((0.0, 0.0, 1.0))
    ref = model.createIfcDirection((1.0, 0.0, 0.0))
    placement = model.createIfcAxis2Placement3D(loc, axis, ref)
    extrusion.Position = placement
    
    return extrusion


def create_local_placement(model, location: Tuple[float, float, float],
                           axis: Tuple[float, float, float] = (0, 0, 1),
                           ref: Tuple[float, float, float] = (1, 0, 0),
                           relative_to=None) -> ifcopenshell.entity_instance:
    """Create an IfcLocalPlacement."""
    loc_m = (location[0]/1000.0, location[1]/1000.0, location[2]/1000.0)
    loc = model.createIfcCartesianPoint(loc_m)
    axis_dir = model.createIfcDirection(axis)
    ref_dir = model.createIfcDirection(ref)
    placement = model.createIfcAxis2Placement3D(loc, axis_dir, ref_dir)
    return model.createIfcLocalPlacement(relative_to, placement)


def create_product(model, element_class: str, name: str, object_type: str,
                   geometry: ifcopenshell.entity_instance,
                   placement: ifcopenshell.entity_instance,
                   representation_context) -> ifcopenshell.entity_instance:
    """Create a product with geometry."""
    # Create shape representation
    shape_repr = model.createIfcShapeRepresentation(
        representation_context,
        "Body",
        "SweptSolid",
        [geometry]
    )
    
    # Product definition shape
    prod_shape = model.createIfcProductDefinitionShape(None, None, [shape_repr])
    
    # Create element
    if element_class == "IfcColumn":
        element = model.createIfcColumn(
            ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, name, None, None,
            placement, prod_shape, None
        )
    elif element_class == "IfcFurniture":
        element = model.createIfcFurniture(
            ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, name, None, None,
            placement, prod_shape, None, object_type
        )
    elif element_class == "IfcFlowSegment":
        element = model.createIfcFlowSegment(
            ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, name, None, None,
            placement, prod_shape, None
        )
    elif element_class == "IfcCableCarrierSegment":
        element = model.createIfcCableCarrierSegment(

            placement, prod_shape, None
        )
    elif element_class == "IfcBuildingElementProxy":
        element = model.createIfcBuildingElementProxy(
            ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, name, None, None,
            placement, prod_shape, None, object_type
        )
    elif element_class == "IfcFlowTerminal":
        element = model.createIfcFlowTerminal(
            ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, name, None, None,
            placement, prod_shape, None
        )
    else:
        element = model.createIfcBuildingElementProxy(
            ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, name, None, None,
            placement, prod_shape, None, object_type
        )
    
    return element


def add_property_set(model, element, pset_name: str, properties: Dict[str, Any]):
    """Add a property set to an element."""
    pset_props = []
    for key, value in properties.items():
        if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
            prop = model.createIfcPropertySingleValue(key, None, 
                model.createIfcReal(value) if isinstance(value, float) else model.createIfcInteger(value), None)
        elif isinstance(value, str):
            prop = model.createIfcPropertySingleValue(key, None, model.createIfcLabel(value), None)
        elif isinstance(value, bool):
            prop = model.createIfcPropertySingleValue(key, None, model.createIfcBoolean(value), None)
        else:
            prop = model.createIfcPropertySingleValue(key, None, model.createIfcLabel(str(value)), None)
        pset_props.append(prop)
    
    pset = model.createIfcPropertySet(ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, pset_name, None, pset_props)
    rel = model.createIfcRelDefinesByProperties(ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, None, None, [element], pset)

# ============================================================
# GEOMETRY HELPERS

def create_extrusion(model, profile_pts: List[Tuple[float, float]], depth: float, 
                     position: Tuple[float, float, float] = (0, 0, 0),
                     rotation: Tuple[float, float, float] = (0, 0, 0)) -> ifcopenshell.entity_instance:
    """Create an IfcExtrudedAreaSolid from 2D profile points (in mm)."""
    # Convert mm to m for IFC
    pts_m = [(x/1000.0, y/1000.0) for x, y in profile_pts]
    depth_m = depth / 1000.0
    pos_m = (position[0]/1000.0, position[1]/1000.0, position[2]/1000.0)
    
    # Create polyline
    points = [model.createIfcCartesianPoint((x, y)) for x, y in pts_m]
    polyline = model.createIfcPolyline(points)
    profile = model.createIfcArbitraryClosedProfileDef("AREA", None, polyline)
    
    # Extrusion direction
    dir_z = model.createIfcDirection((0.0, 0.0, 1.0))
    extrusion = model.createIfcExtrudedAreaSolid(profile, None, dir_z, depth_m)
    
    # Placement
    loc = model.createIfcCartesianPoint(pos_m)
    axis = model.createIfcDirection((0.0, 0.0, 1.0))
    ref = model.createIfcDirection((1.0, 0.0, 0.0))
    placement = model.createIfcAxis2Placement3D(loc, axis, ref)
    extrusion.Position = placement
    
    return extrusion


def create_rectangular_extrusion(model, width: float, height: float, depth: float,
                                  position: Tuple[float, float, float] = (0, 0, 0)) -> ifcopenshell.entity_instance:
    """Create a rectangular extrusion."""
    pts = [(0, 0), (width, 0), (width, height), (0, height)]
    return create_extrusion(model, pts, depth, position)


def create_circular_extrusion(model, radius: float, depth: float,
                               position: Tuple[float, float, float] = (0, 0, 0)) -> ifcopenshell.entity_instance:
    """Create a circular extrusion (pipe)."""
    radius_m = radius / 1000.0
    depth_m = depth / 1000.0
    pos_m = (position[0]/1000.0, position[1]/1000.0, position[2]/1000.0)
    
    circle = model.createIfcCircle(model.createIfcAxis2Placement2D(
        model.createIfcCartesianPoint((0.0, 0.0))), radius_m)
    profile = model.createIfcArbitraryClosedProfileDef("AREA", None, circle)
    
    dir_z = model.createIfcDirection((0.0, 0.0, 1.0))
    extrusion = model.createIfcExtrudedAreaSolid(profile, None, dir_z, depth_m)
    
    loc = model.createIfcCartesianPoint(pos_m)
    axis = model.createIfcDirection((0.0, 0.0, 1.0))
    ref = model.createIfcDirection((1.0, 0.0, 0.0))
    placement = model.createIfcAxis2Placement3D(loc, axis, ref)
    extrusion.Position = placement
    
    return extrusion


def create_local_placement(model, location: Tuple[float, float, float],
                           axis: Tuple[float, float, float] = (0, 0, 1),
                           ref: Tuple[float, float, float] = (1, 0, 0),
                           relative_to=None) -> ifcopenshell.entity_instance:
    """Create an IfcLocalPlacement."""
    loc_m = [location[0]/1000.0, location[1]/1000.0, location[2]/1000.0]
    loc = model.createIfcCartesianPoint(loc_m)
    axis_dir = model.createIfcDirection(list(axis))
    ref_dir = model.createIfcDirection(list(ref))
    placement = model.createIfcAxis2Placement3D(loc, axis_dir, ref_dir)
    return model.createIfcLocalPlacement(relative_to, placement)


def create_product(model, element_class: str, name: str, object_type: str,
                   geometry: ifcopenshell.entity_instance,
                   placement: ifcopenshell.entity_instance,
                   representation_context) -> ifcopenshell.entity_instance:
    """Create a product with geometry."""
    # Create shape representation
    shape_repr = model.createIfcShapeRepresentation(
        representation_context,

        "SweptSolid",

    )
    
    # Product definition shape
    prod_shape = model.createIfcProductDefinitionShape(None, None, [shape_repr])
    
    # Create element
    if element_class == "IfcColumn":
        element = model.createIfcColumn(
            ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, name, None, None,
            placement, prod_shape, None
        )
    elif element_class == "IfcFurniture":
        element = model.createIfcFurniture(
            ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, name, None, None,
            placement, prod_shape, None, object_type
        )
    elif element_class == "IfcFlowSegment":
        element = model.createIfcFlowSegment(
            ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, name, None, None,
            placement, prod_shape, None
        )
    elif element_class == "IfcCableCarrierSegment":
        element = model.createIfcCableCarrierSegment(
            ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, name, None, None,
            placement, prod_shape, None
        )
    elif element_class == "IfcBuildingElementProxy":
        element = model.createIfcBuildingElementProxy(
            ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, name, None, None,
            placement, prod_shape, None, object_type
        )
    elif element_class == "IfcFlowTerminal":
        element = model.createIfcFlowTerminal(
            ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, name, None, None,
            placement, prod_shape, None
        )
    else:
        element = model.createIfcBuildingElementProxy(
            ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, name, None, None,
            placement, prod_shape, None, object_type
        )
    
    return element


def add_property_set(model, element, pset_name: str, properties: Dict[str, Any]):
    """Add a property set to an element."""
    pset_props = []
    for key, value in properties.items():
        if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
            prop = model.createIfcPropertySingleValue(key, None, 
                model.createIfcReal(value) if isinstance(value, float) else model.createIfcInteger(value), None)
        elif isinstance(value, str):
            prop = model.createIfcPropertySingleValue(key, None, model.createIfcLabel(value), None)
        elif isinstance(value, bool):
            prop = model.createIfcPropertySingleValue(key, None, model.createIfcBoolean(value), None)
        else:
            prop = model.createIfcPropertySingleValue(key, None, model.createIfcLabel(str(value)), None)
        pset_props.append(prop)
    
    pset = model.createIfcPropertySet(ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, pset_name, None, pset_props)
    rel = model.createIfcRelDefinesByProperties(ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, None, None, [element], pset)
    return pset

def create_extrusion(model, profile_pts: List[Tuple[float, float]], depth: float, 
                     position: Tuple[float, float, float] = (0, 0, 0),
                     rotation: Tuple[float, float, float] = (0, 0, 0)) -> ifcopenshell.entity_instance:
    """Create an IfcExtrudedAreaSolid from 2D profile points (in mm)."""
    # Convert mm to m for IFC
    pts_m = [(x/1000.0, y/1000.0) for x, y in profile_pts]
    depth_m = depth / 1000.0
    pos_m = (position[0]/1000.0, position[1]/1000.0, position[2]/1000.0)
    
    # Create polyline
    points = [model.createIfcCartesianPoint((x, y)) for x, y in pts_m]
    polyline = model.createIfcPolyline(points)
    profile = model.createIfcArbitraryClosedProfileDef("AREA", None, polyline)
    
    # Extrusion direction
    dir_z = model.createIfcDirection((0.0, 0.0, 1.0))
    extrusion = model.createIfcExtrudedAreaSolid(profile, None, dir_z, depth_m)
    
    # Placement
    loc = model.createIfcCartesianPoint(pos_m)
    axis = model.createIfcDirection((0.0, 0.0, 1.0))
    ref = model.createIfcDirection((1.0, 0.0, 0.0))
    placement = model.createIfcAxis2Placement3D(loc, axis, ref)
    extrusion.Position = placement
    
    return extrusion


def create_rectangular_extrusion(model, width: float, height: float, depth: float,
                                  position: Tuple[float, float, float] = (0, 0, 0)) -> ifcopenshell.entity_instance:
    """Create a rectangular extrusion."""
    pts = [(0, 0), (width, 0), (width, height), (0, height)]
    return create_extrusion(model, pts, depth, position)


def create_circular_extrusion(model, radius: float, depth: float,
                               position: Tuple[float, float, float] = (0, 0, 0)) -> ifcopenshell.entity_instance:
    """Create a circular extrusion (pipe)."""
    radius_m = radius / 1000.0
    depth_m = depth / 1000.0
    pos_m = (position[0]/1000.0, position[1]/1000.0, position[2]/1000.0)
    
    circle = model.createIfcCircle(model.createIfcAxis2Placement2D(
        model.createIfcCartesianPoint((0.0, 0.0))), radius_m)
    profile = model.createIfcArbitraryClosedProfileDef("AREA", None, circle)
    
    dir_z = model.createIfcDirection((0.0, 0.0, 1.0))
    extrusion = model.createIfcExtrudedAreaSolid(profile, None, dir_z, depth_m)
    
    loc = model.createIfcCartesianPoint(pos_m)
    axis = model.createIfcDirection((0.0, 0.0, 1.0))
    ref = model.createIfcDirection((1.0, 0.0, 0.0))
    placement = model.createIfcAxis2Placement3D(loc, axis, ref)
    extrusion.Position = placement

def create_local_placement(model, location: Tuple[float, float, float],
                           axis: Tuple[float, float, float] = (0.0, 0.0, 1.0),
                           ref: Tuple[float, float, float] = (1.0, 0.0, 0.0),
                           relative_to=None) -> ifcopenshell.entity_instance:
    """Create an IfcLocalPlacement."""
    loc_m = [float(location[0])/1000.0, float(location[1])/1000.0, float(location[2])/1000.0]
    loc = model.createIfcCartesianPoint(loc_m)
    axis_dir = model.createIfcDirection([float(axis[0]), float(axis[1]), float(axis[2])])
    ref_dir = model.createIfcDirection([float(ref[0]), float(ref[1]), float(ref[2])])
    placement = model.createIfcAxis2Placement3D(loc, axis_dir, ref_dir)
    return model.createIfcLocalPlacement(relative_to, placement)

        )

        )

        )

def add_property_set(model, element, pset_name: str, properties: Dict[str, Any]):
    """Add a property set to an element."""
    pset_props = []
    for key, value in properties.items():
        if isinstance(value, (int, float)):

def create_extrusion(model, profile_pts: List[Tuple[float, float]], depth: float, 
                     position: Tuple[float, float, float] = (0, 0, 0),
                     rotation: Tuple[float, float, float] = (0, 0, 0)) -> ifcopenshell.entity_instance:
    """Create an IfcExtrudedAreaSolid from 2D profile points (in mm)."""
    # Convert mm to m for IFC
    pts_m = [(x/1000.0, y/1000.0) for x, y in profile_pts]
    depth_m = depth / 1000.0
    pos_m = (position[0]/1000.0, position[1]/1000.0, position[2]/1000.0)
    
    # Create polyline
    points = [model.createIfcCartesianPoint((x, y)) for x, y in pts_m]
    polyline = model.createIfcPolyline(points)
    profile = model.createIfcArbitraryClosedProfileDef("AREA", None, polyline)
    
    # Extrusion direction
    dir_z = model.createIfcDirection((0.0, 0.0, 1.0))
    extrusion = model.createIfcExtrudedAreaSolid(profile, None, dir_z, depth_m)
    
    # Placement
    loc = model.createIfcCartesianPoint(pos_m)
    axis = model.createIfcDirection((0.0, 0.0, 1.0))
    ref = model.createIfcDirection((1.0, 0.0, 0.0))
    placement = model.createIfcAxis2Placement3D(loc, axis, ref)
    extrusion.Position = placement
    
    return extrusion


def create_rectangular_extrusion(model, width: float, height: float, depth: float,
                                  position: Tuple[float, float, float] = (0, 0, 0)) -> ifcopenshell.entity_instance:
    """Create a rectangular extrusion."""
    pts = [(0, 0), (width, 0), (width, height), (0, height)]
    return create_extrusion(model, pts, depth, position)


def create_circular_extrusion(model, radius: float, depth: float,
                               position: Tuple[float, float, float] = (0, 0, 0)) -> ifcopenshell.entity_instance:
    """Create a circular extrusion (pipe)."""
    radius_m = radius / 1000.0
    depth_m = depth / 1000.0
    pos_m = (position[0]/1000.0, position[1]/1000.0, position[2]/1000.0)
    
    circle = model.createIfcCircle(model.createIfcAxis2Placement2D(
        model.createIfcCartesianPoint((0.0, 0.0))), radius_m)
    profile = model.createIfcArbitraryClosedProfileDef("AREA", None, circle)
    
    dir_z = model.createIfcDirection((0.0, 0.0, 1.0))
    extrusion = model.createIfcExtrudedAreaSolid(profile, None, dir_z, depth_m)
    
    loc = model.createIfcCartesianPoint(pos_m)
    axis = model.createIfcDirection((0.0, 0.0, 1.0))
    ref = model.createIfcDirection((1.0, 0.0, 0.0))
    placement = model.createIfcAxis2Placement3D(loc, axis, ref)
    extrusion.Position = placement

def create_local_placement(model, location: Tuple[float, float, float],
                           axis: Tuple[float, float, float] = (0.0, 0.0, 1.0),
                           ref: Tuple[float, float, float] = (1.0, 0.0, 0.0),
                           relative_to=None) -> ifcopenshell.entity_instance:
    """Create an IfcLocalPlacement."""
    loc_m = [float(location[0])/1000.0, float(location[1])/1000.0, float(location[2])/1000.0]
    loc = model.createIfcCartesianPoint(loc_m)
    axis_dir = model.createIfcDirection([float(axis[0]), float(axis[1]), float(axis[2])])
    ref_dir = model.createIfcDirection([float(ref[0]), float(ref[1]), float(ref[2])])
    placement = model.createIfcAxis2Placement3D(loc, axis_dir, ref_dir)
    return model.createIfcLocalPlacement(relative_to, placement)

# ============================================================
# GEOMETRY HELPERS
# ============================================================

def create_extrusion(model, profile_pts: List[Tuple[float, float]], depth: float, 
                     position: Tuple[float, float, float] = (0, 0, 0),
                     rotation: Tuple[float, float, float] = (0, 0, 0)) -> ifcopenshell.entity_instance:
    """Create an IfcExtrudedAreaSolid from 2D profile points (in mm)."""
    # Convert mm to m for IFC
    pts_m = [(x/1000.0, y/1000.0) for x, y in profile_pts]
    depth_m = depth / 1000.0
    pos_m = (position[0]/1000.0, position[1]/1000.0, position[2]/1000.0)
    
    # Create polyline
    points = [model.createIfcCartesianPoint((x, y)) for x, y in pts_m]
    polyline = model.createIfcPolyline(points)
    profile = model.createIfcArbitraryClosedProfileDef("AREA", None, polyline)
    
    # Extrusion direction
    dir_z = model.createIfcDirection((0.0, 0.0, 1.0))
    extrusion = model.createIfcExtrudedAreaSolid(profile, None, dir_z, depth_m)
    
    # Placement
    loc = model.createIfcCartesianPoint(pos_m)
    axis = model.createIfcDirection((0.0, 0.0, 1.0))
    ref = model.createIfcDirection((1.0, 0.0, 0.0))
    placement = model.createIfcAxis2Placement3D(loc, axis, ref)
    extrusion.Position = placement
    
    return extrusion


def create_rectangular_extrusion(model, width: float, height: float, depth: float,
                                  position: Tuple[float, float, float] = (0, 0, 0)) -> ifcopenshell.entity_instance:
    """Create a rectangular extrusion."""
    pts = [(0, 0), (width, 0), (width, height), (0, height)]
    return create_extrusion(model, pts, depth, position)


def create_circular_extrusion(model, radius: float, depth: float,
                               position: Tuple[float, float, float] = (0, 0, 0)) -> ifcopenshell.entity_instance:
    """Create a circular extrusion (pipe)."""
    radius_m = radius / 1000.0
    depth_m = depth / 1000.0
    pos_m = (position[0]/1000.0, position[1]/1000.0, position[2]/1000.0)
    
    circle = model.createIfcCircle(model.createIfcAxis2Placement2D(
        model.createIfcCartesianPoint((0.0, 0.0))), radius_m)
    profile = model.createIfcArbitraryClosedProfileDef("AREA", None, circle)
    
    dir_z = model.createIfcDirection((0.0, 0.0, 1.0))
    extrusion = model.createIfcExtrudedAreaSolid(profile, None, dir_z, depth_m)
    
    loc = model.createIfcCartesianPoint(pos_m)
    axis = model.createIfcDirection((0.0, 0.0, 1.0))
    ref = model.createIfcDirection((1.0, 0.0, 0.0))
    placement = model.createIfcAxis2Placement3D(loc, axis, ref)
    extrusion.Position = placement
    
    return extrusion


def create_local_placement(model, location: Tuple[float, float, float],
                           axis: Tuple[float, float, float] = (0.0, 0.0, 1.0),
                           ref: Tuple[float, float, float] = (1.0, 0.0, 0.0),
                           relative_to=None) -> ifcopenshell.entity_instance:
    """Create an IfcLocalPlacement."""
    loc_m = [float(location[0])/1000.0, float(location[1])/1000.0, float(location[2])/1000.0]
    loc = model.createIfcCartesianPoint(loc_m)
    axis_dir = model.createIfcDirection([float(axis[0]), float(axis[1]), float(axis[2])])
    ref_dir = model.createIfcDirection([float(ref[0]), float(ref[1]), float(ref[2])])
    placement = model.createIfcAxis2Placement3D(loc, axis_dir, ref_dir)
    return model.createIfcLocalPlacement(relative_to, placement)


def create_product(model, element_class: str, name: str, object_type: str,
                   geometry: ifcopenshell.entity_instance,
                   placement: ifcopenshell.entity_instance,
                   representation_context) -> ifcopenshell.entity_instance:
    """Create a product with geometry."""
    # Create shape representation
    shape_repr = model.createIfcShapeRepresentation(
        representation_context,
        "Body",
        "SweptSolid",
        [geometry]
    )
    
    # Product definition shape
    prod_shape = model.createIfcProductDefinitionShape(None, None, [shape_repr])
    
    # Create element
    if element_class == "IfcColumn":
        element = model.createIfcColumn(
            ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, name, None, None,
            placement, prod_shape, None
        )
    elif element_class == "IfcFurniture":
        element = model.createIfcFurniture(
            ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, name, None, None,
            placement, prod_shape, None, object_type
        )
    elif element_class == "IfcFlowSegment":
        element = model.createIfcFlowSegment(
            ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, name, None, None,
            placement, prod_shape, None
        )
    elif element_class == "IfcCableCarrierSegment":
        element = model.createIfcCableCarrierSegment(
            ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, name, None, None,
            placement, prod_shape, None
        )
    elif element_class == "IfcBuildingElementProxy":
        element = model.createIfcBuildingElementProxy(
            ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, name, None, None,
            placement, prod_shape, None, object_type
        )
    elif element_class == "IfcFlowTerminal":
        element = model.createIfcFlowTerminal(
            ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, name, None, None,
            placement, prod_shape, None
        )
    else:
        element = model.createIfcBuildingElementProxy(
            ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, name, None, None,
            placement, prod_shape, None, object_type
        )
    
    return element


def add_property_set(model, element, pset_name: str, properties: Dict[str, Any]):
    """Add a property set to an element."""
    pset_props = []
    for key, value in properties.items():
        if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
            prop = model.createIfcPropertySingleValue(key, None, 
                model.createIfcReal(value) if isinstance(value, float) else model.createIfcInteger(value), None)
        elif isinstance(value, str):
            prop = model.createIfcPropertySingleValue(key, None, model.createIfcLabel(value), None)
        elif isinstance(value, bool):
            prop = model.createIfcPropertySingleValue(key, None, model.createIfcBoolean(value), None)
        else:
            prop = model.createIfcPropertySingleValue(key, None, model.createIfcLabel(str(value)), None)
        pset_props.append(prop)
    
    pset = model.createIfcPropertySet(ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, pset_name, None, pset_props)
    rel = model.createIfcRelDefinesByProperties(ifcopenshell.guid.new(), None, None, None, [element], pset)
    return pset

#!/usr/bin/env python3

import sys

# ============================================================

# Room dimensions (mm)
